about.title: Mars College
about.what: A desert campus for shared study, art, making and communal life. Chiba hosts presentations; Mimos offers café, study and tea spaces; the kitchen, workshops and living compounds support everyday activity.
about.tour: Begin with Chiba for an auditorium presentation or gallery visit, Mimos for coffee and a seated conversation, or the campus kitchen for the dining hall. Tool Camp combines workbenches and a reading corner; Freeside and CoLab form the living and workshop compound. The Dojo is for practice and movement. The old tire track is an outdoor landmark beyond the main buildings.
